summary: Completed the final three phases of plan 08 (Phases 9.1, 9.2, 10), finishing the whole 18-phase plan and the task. Phase 9.1's outer fuel induction (modalExpandBranchesS4KeyedOrdered_closed_False, FrameCompleteness.lean) was the remaining hard blocker from the prior dispatch's Progress Record, which had stalled on a base-case membership-transport argument in a List.Forall2-over-a-bundled-triple design. This dispatch resolved it with a different design: since S4RedirectSoundInv_step's own conclusion is already existential (only ONE child branch is guaranteed to inherit the invariant per step, never all of them), a lighter existential 4-column threading relation (Ex4Inv, built from nested List.zip as zip4) suffices in place of a universal Forall2 relation, avoiding the stalled base case entirely. Supporting infrastructure (S4KOFullInv, modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_newExps_eq_map, zip4, mem_zip_of_mem_map_const, Ex4Inv_of_mem_const, zip4_append, Ex4Inv_embedLeft/embedRight, mem_zip4_proj13, zip4_cons_mem_cases) plus the outer induction itself total ~285 lines, all sorry-free, all machine-checked on first or second attempt per lemma. Phase 9.2's capstone (modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_sound) is a thin ~35-line corollary that compiled on the FIRST attempt, confirming the Phase 9 Scope Decision's estimate. Phase 10 added a permanent type-level regression witness row to CslibTests/S4LoopGuardRegression.lean (additive only, every pre-existing #guard_msgs row byte-identical) and ran the full 8-step CSLib CI pipeline: cache get (warm), whole-library build (3313 jobs, 0 errors), checkInitImports (clean), lake lint (145 pre-existing warnings, all in unrelated files, zero in this task's files), lint-style (clean), lake test (9378/9378, 0 errors), mk_all --module (no-op), lake shake (no suggestions for this task's files). Sorry census held at exactly 1 (FrameSoundness.lean:1251, the standing user-decision sorry) after every commit through this dispatch. #print axioms via lake env lean confirmed exactly {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} on both the outer induction theorem and the capstone. One operational note recorded honestly rather than papered over: a second full-project lake lint attempt (between Phases 9.1 and 9.2) did not complete, apparently starved by unrelated concurrent lean/lake processes from another project on the same host; a third attempt after system load settled completed cleanly and is the result recorded in the plan and this handoff.
